verdict.rationale: Lium's docs name a first-party MCP server at `/mcp` that an agent can connect to, so the axis applies and the product itself provides it. Its documented tools are limited to docs search/read and live GPU prices and availability with rent links. Renting and managing pods goes through the CLI, SDK and API instead. Missing for 10: MCP tools for renting/managing pods, documented connection/auth/transport setup, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use the MCP server at `/mcp` to search and read the docs (`search`, `read_page`) and to see live GPU prices and availability with rent links
